watchFor: 玻璃核心的平坦度與通孔可靠度需共同驗證。
將核心翹曲、通孔裂紋和增層界面分開。
標記畫面中未展示、仍需額外量測的界面。
watchForEn: Glass-core flatness and via reliability need joint verification.
Separate core warpage, via cracks and build-up interfaces.
Identify interfaces not shown that still require measurement.
videos.before: 先寫下本課的圖像判讀問題：玻璃核心的平坦度與通孔可靠度需共同驗證。
videos.beforeEn: Write the visual-reading question for this course: Glass-core flatness and via reliability need joint verification.
videos.after: 完成觀察工作單，列出影片未能證明的三件事，並為每一件指定量測或來源。
videos.afterEn: Complete the worksheet. List three claims not established by the video and specify a measurement or source for each.

videos.title: Intel：60 秒認識玻璃封裝基板
watchFor: 玻璃核心與有機材料在平坦度及熱機械行為上有所差異。
分清測試單元、技術計畫與已量產產品三種證據。
基板材料改變仍需共同驗證通孔、金屬化及組裝界面。
watchForEn: Glass cores and organic materials differ in flatness and thermomechanical behavior.
Distinguish test units, technology plans and production products as separate evidence levels.
A substrate-material change still requires via, metallization and assembly-interface validation.
videos.scope: 本課「玻璃核心封裝基板」的延伸背景。2023 年公開玻璃基板案例；不要把當時路線圖當成目前已完成的產品狀態。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Glass-core package substrates. A public 2023 glass-substrate case; do not treat its roadmap as proof of current product readiness. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.author: Intel Newsroom
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「定義核心與增層」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Define core and build-up requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「估算熱失配」列為查證任務：觀察焦點：重算 12 μm 差位移並說明不是裂紋張開量。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Estimate thermal mismatch: Observation focus: Recalculate 12 μm mismatch and explain why it is not crack opening. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

courses.overview: 相似工法的重點是可轉移的物理與證據；下列比較保留各自不同的材料和模型邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Related methods share transferable physics and evidence while retaining distinct materials and model boundaries.

related.title: 玻璃穿孔製作
related.why: TGV 形貌與金屬填充連到核心功能
related.whyEn: TGV shape and metal filling enable the core
related.transfer: TGV 形貌與金屬填充連到核心功能
related.transferEn: TGV shape and metal filling enable the core
related.difference: 核心整合還需增層、翹曲與系統可靠度
related.differenceEn: Core integration adds build-up, warpage and system reliability
practice: 畫出「玻璃核心封裝基板」與「玻璃穿孔製作」的材料、能量或資料交接。
以「定義核心與增層」為比較起點，指出兩課共享的守恆或量測原理。
提出一個會使「TGV 形貌與金屬填充連到核心功能」失效的邊界條件，並安排驗證。
practiceEn: Draw the material, energy or data handoff between Glass-core package substrates and Through-glass-via fabrication.
Use define core and build-up to identify a shared conservation or measurement principle.
State and test one boundary that would invalidate this transfer: TGV shape and metal filling enable the core

courses.summary: 本課以玻璃核心平整度、TGV 與脆裂風險連結材料、模型與驗證。地圖採 imec 公開研究園區作為跨領域整合的代表點；製造、量測及可靠度資料則分別引用材料廠、工具商與研究機構。這個位置提供研究脈絡，不把全球供應鏈誤縮成一處工廠。
courses.summaryEn: This course connects materials, models and validation through glass-core flatness, tgvs and brittle-fracture risk. Imec’s public campus is a reference for interdisciplinary integration; manufacturing, metrology and reliability sources also come from vendors and research institutions. The map provides research context rather than reducing the global supply chain to one factory.

history.title: 合作研究中心在魯汶成立
history.titleEn: A collaborative research center starts in Leuven
history.text: imec 官方歷史記錄其成立背景；共同研究模式使材料、元件和系統問題能在同一研究環境連結。
history.textEn: Imec’s official history records its establishment; collaborative research connects materials, devices and systems in one research environment.

history.title: 微流體散熱連結晶片與系統
history.titleEn: Microfluidic cooling connects chips and systems
history.text: imec 公開介紹矽微流道研究，說明晶片性能需與散熱及封裝一起思考；此為研究展示，不是所有課程的量產規格。
history.textEn: Imec publicly described silicon microchannel research, illustrating the need to consider chip performance together with cooling and packaging. This is a research demonstration, not a production specification for every course.

courses.connection: 將地圖視為研究交流的定位點，再依每個來源了解不同機構在材料、設備、量測與系統驗證上的分工。
courses.connectionEn: Use the map as a research reference, then trace each source’s role in materials, equipment, metrology and system validation.
